description.en: The list of instance group IDs.

description.zh: 实例组名称。支持模糊查询。
description.en: The instance group name. Fuzzy match is supported.
The ID of the key pair.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围1～100，默认值为100。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100.

description.zh: 用来表示当前开始读取的位置。置空表示从头开始。
description.en: The pagination token that indicates the position from which the current read operation starts. Leave this parameter empty to read from the beginning.
The purchase mode of the cloud phone.

description.zh: 实例组的标签。每个实例最多可绑定20个标签。
description.en: The tags of the instance group. You can bind up to 20 tags to each instance.

description.zh:
标签键。可包含 1~20 个。
><notice>标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，也不能包含http://或https://。></notice>
description.en:
The tag key. You can specify 1 to 20 tag keys.
><notice>The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http:// or https://.></notice>.

description.zh:
标签值。
><notice>标签值最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。></notice>
description.en:
The tag value.
><notice>The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.></notice>.
